name: Spreadsheet to App
tagline: Turn Google Sheets into web apps with AI
description: Spreadsheet to App is a web app builder operated by LOUGAO, LLC. Connect Google Sheets or import an Excel or CSV file into your own Google Sheets, then use AI Studio to generate an app. Refine it in chat, inspect and edit its code, preview privately, and publish when ready. Data stays in Google Sheets. Uses include inventory tools, customer lists, dashboards and internal workflows. Later edits to the original Excel or CSV file do not sync after import. A Google account and Sheets connection are required. Freemium: the free workspace includes one app, one seat and limited AI. Basic is $25 per workspace per month for five apps and two seats; higher paid tiers are available. See https://spreadsheettoapp.ai/pricing for current limits. Submitted by an authorized representative.
